{{Quote|I am Lachei. I helped to scout the way for you&hellip; and there are more than beasts in those old dens.|Lachei|<ref name="Hunting the Hunter" />}}
'''Lachei''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] scout who worked with the civilian resistance on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], Lachei located the command unit of the hunter droids the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vermilion (bounty hunter)|Vermilion]] was using to hunt Selonians, and Republic forces were able to end the droids' threat.<ref name="Hunting the Hunter" />
